audit.description: Changed production files replace colorama imports and constants with real termcolor usage: repopack/utils/cli_output.py and repopack/utils/logger.py import `colored` from `termcolor` and call it for colored output. Static and dynamic evidence show no source-library use from production repository code, while dynamic target imports resolve to site-packages termcolor rather than a local shim.
evidence: Diff: repopack/utils/cli_output.py removes `import colorama` and `from colorama import Fore, Style`, adds `from termcolor import colored`, and replaces Fore/Style formatting with colored(...) calls.
Diff: repopack/utils/logger.py removes `from colorama import Fore, Style, init`, adds `from termcolor import colored`, and uses colored(...) for level names and TRACE messages.
Static anti-cheat file checks: repopack/utils/cli_output.py and repopack/utils/logger.py have imports_target=true and imports_source=false.

Dynamic anti-cheat metrics: first_target_events_from_repo records termcolor imports in repopack/utils/logger.py and repopack/utils/cli_output.py; source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0; target_local_spec_count=0.
reasons: Production code meaningfully imports and calls termcolor.colored in changed files.
No changed production file statically imports colorama or accesses colorama APIs.
Dynamic audit reports zero source imports from production repo and target imports from production repo.
No fake target provider evidence: target_local_spec_count is 0 and termcolor origin is site-packages.
